es.titular: El peso devuelve su ganancia y vuelve a 19.05; el IPC aguanta plano pese a Wall Street
esencial: A las 11:38 CDMX el peso cotizaba en 19.05 por dólar (−0.02% el dólar), después de llegar a 18.97 en la apertura.
El S&P/BMV IPC estaba plano en 68,719.98 puntos (+0.01%) a las 11:18 CDMX, mientras el S&P 500 caía 2.2%.
Para supply chain: hoy rige el FIX de 18.6723 y el lunes el de 19.0270; liquida hoy los pagos en dólares que puedas.

bloques.x: A las 11:18 CDMX el S&P/BMV IPC estaba en 68,719.98 puntos (+0.01%), pese a la caída de 2.2% del S&P 500. Hoy rige el FIX de 18.6723; el determinado ayer, de 19.0270, rige para pagos desde el lunes 23.

en.titular: The peso gives back its gain and returns to 19.05; the IPC holds flat despite Wall Street
esencial: At 11:38 a.m. Mexico City time the peso traded at 19.05 per dollar (dollar −0.02%), after reaching 18.97 at the open.
The S&P/BMV IPC was flat at 68,719.98 points (+0.01%) at 11:18 a.m., while the S&P 500 fell 2.2%.
For supply chain: today the 18.6723 FIX applies and on Monday the 19.0270 one; settle the dollar payments you can today.

bloques.x: At 11:18 a.m. Mexico City time the S&P/BMV IPC stood at 68,719.98 points (+0.01%), despite the 2.2% drop in the S&P 500. At 11:38 a.m. the peso traded at 19.05 per dollar (dollar −0.02%), after reaching 18.97 at the open: the tech sell-off and the drop in metals erased its gain. Today the 18.6723 FIX applies; the one set yesterday, 19.0270, applies to payments from Monday the 23rd.
The drop in gold (−4.2%), silver (−7.5%) and copper (−2.7%) weighs on miners. The 10-year Treasury yield falls to 4.94%, but markets expect another Fed hike in December.
